instruction: How to list all ArgoCD RBAC role bindings
output: argocd admin settings rbac role-bindings list

instruction: How to create an ArgoCD RBAC role binding
output: argocd admin settings rbac role-bindings create --role my-role --subject my-user --subject-type User

instruction: How to delete an ArgoCD RBAC role binding
output: argocd admin settings rbac role-bindings delete my-binding
